expansion_contract.fact_row: verified official-source, canonical-state, workflow-evidence or acceptance-contract fact
expansion_contract.boundary_row: prevents satellite take-up, mobile prediction pixels, signal thresholds, traffic-cell geography or Locale classes from being promoted to exact fixed-broadband postcode or parcel coverage without accepted r2 bytes and hardened postjoin evidence

source_routes.name: Methodology Annex satellite and mobile screenshots
About this data fixed coverage v2

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

facts.detail: The exact 11,013-row output JSONL remains empty.
The source snapshot remains exact_rows_returned zero and source_scan_complete remains false.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact r2 and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: The UK satellite analysis was limited to one provider offering Low Earth Orbit broadband directly to consumers.
The satellite analysis focused on service take-up and geographic distribution rather than assigning universal availability to every premise.

guard_streams.write_limit: LEO capability cannot be converted into an exact fixed-line parcel metric.

facts.detail: Geographic coordinates of satellite customer-premises equipment were used in the analysis.
Those coordinates were mapped to the nearest UPRN and compared with other network technologies available at the location.

guard_streams.write_limit: Nearest-UPRN mapping is analytical linkage, not exact fixed-broadband coverage evidence.

facts.detail: Mobile coverage data was collected from BT/EE, Three, Virgin Media O2 and Vodafone.
Coverage predictions were supplied as 100 metre by 100 metre pixels referenced to the OSGB grid.

guard_streams.write_limit: A mobile prediction pixel cannot populate a fixed postcode speed field.

facts.detail: Mobile premises coverage used the July 2025 Connected Nations premise base derived from AddressBase Premium and Islands Epoch 119.
The premise base was enriched with the May 2025 ONS 2021 Census postcode lookup and Locale urban-rural classifications.

guard_streams.write_limit: Historical mobile premise enrichment cannot replace January 2026 exact r2 coverage.

facts.detail: Technology-specific signal thresholds are applied to each 100 metre pixel.
Qualified pixels are aggregated to estimate covered landmass or covered premises.

guard_streams.write_limit: Aggregated mobile coverage is not an address-level fixed observation.

facts.detail: 2G, 3G and 4G coverage thresholds target at least a 98 percent probability of successfully completing a 90-second voice call.
The 4G definition also reflects at least a 95 percent chance of obtaining a download speed of at least 2 Mbit/s.

guard_streams.write_limit: Mobile probability thresholds cannot be written as fixed parcel throughput.

facts.detail: The 2G RxLev thresholds are -81 dBm outdoors and -71 dBm for indoor and in-car reporting.
The 3G RSCP CPiCH thresholds are -100 dBm outdoors and -90 dBm for indoor and in-car reporting.

guard_streams.write_limit: Signal-strength thresholds are technology definitions, not fixed coverage values.

guard_streams.source: CN2025 Methodology Annex table and screenshot

facts.detail: The 4G RSRP thresholds are -105 dBm outdoors and -95 dBm for indoor and in-car reporting.
Outdoor 5G and 5G SA use -110 dBm for High Confidence and -100 dBm for Very High Confidence.

guard_streams.write_limit: Mobile dBm thresholds cannot raise fixed-postcode candidate confidence.

facts.detail: The 5G High Confidence level is associated with at least an 80 percent probability that coverage is present at the predicted location.
The Very High Confidence level is associated with a probability of around 95 percent.

guard_streams.write_limit: Prediction probability is not a parcel-level fixed service guarantee.

facts.detail: MNO input predictions are supplied on a 50 percent confidence basis across a pixel.
Higher confidence levels account for prediction error, local variability and handset performance, with a combined effect taken to be around 12 dB.

guard_streams.write_limit: Modelled confidence adjustment cannot substitute for an exact fixed archive join.

facts.detail: Mobile traffic data contains uploaded and downloaded volumes for each cell across the four mobile networks.
Traffic geography is defined by the associated mobile cell base-station location.

guard_streams.write_limit: Cell-site traffic cannot be attributed to a fixed postcode or parcel.

facts.detail: Locale Groups A to E are classified as Urban and Groups F and G as Rural.
Fixed premises inherit the Locale class of their postcode-linked output area, while mobile pixels are assigned through OSGB spatial comparison with output-area polygons.

guard_streams.write_limit: Locale categories are contextual classifications, not exact service observations.
